facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/generator:hsd_8039DAD4
facts.value: If `gen->count` is below 1, the function returns without emission. Otherwise it emits repeatedly while count remains at least 1 and subtracts exactly 1 after each iteration. Shape codes 0, 3, 4, 6, and 7 share radial or conical emission; 1 emits along a line; 2 emits tornado parameters; 5 emits within or on selected faces of a rectangular volume; and 8 emits over a spherical region. Other values invoke the optional custom callback. Orientation may incorporate normalized JObj axes, camera-facing axes, and velocity alignment.
facts.reason: Record shape-specific and numerical limits instead of uniform stepping/pure-rotation guarantees.
